8. **Cloud 9 Spa** (Additional) – Full-service spa offering massages, thermal suites, acupuncture, facials, and salon treatments.
9. **Heroes Tribute Bar & Lounge** (Additional) – Dedicated bar and lounge celebrating military service members.
10. **Havana Bar** (Additional) – Cuban-style lounge with handcrafted cocktails, Latin music, and dancing.
